name: The Biscuit Tin
tagline: A tin of shortbread biscuits. There are 24, for now.
summary: A tin of 24 shortbread biscuits. £16. Not returnable once opened.
concept: A round tin of 24 all-butter shortbread biscuits, baked fresh.
why_it_exists: Every family has a biscuit tin that does not hold biscuits. This one does.
target_customer: Anyone who wants biscuits, or who has been disappointed by a tin before.

physical.form: A round lidded tin holding 24 shortbread biscuits in two layers.
materials: Steel tin with a printed lid
Shortbread: wheat flour, butter, sugar, salt

features: There are 24 shortbread biscuits in the tin, laid in two layers.
The biscuits are shortbread made with butter.
The round tin has a lid that fits snugly, so the biscuits stay crisp.
Once the biscuits are gone, the tin is yours to keep and fill with anything you like.
It needs no fridge, so you can leave the tin on the side.
arrives: The tin is packed in a brown card box with paper cushioning around it, so the lid and the biscuits arrive in one piece. The parcel is a plain box with no plastic inside. Open it, and the tin is ready to eat from.
specs: 18 cm across x 8 cm tall (round tin)
About 600 g with biscuits (biscuits about 480 g)
Steel tin with a printed lid, paper liner
Off-white tin with sunflower yellow and orange print
24 shortbread biscuits, about 20 g each, in two layers of 12
Contains wheat (gluten) and milk. Made in a kitchen that also handles nuts, egg and soy.
At least 6 weeks from dispatch, printed on the tin
how_it_works: Open the lid. Eat the biscuits. Keep the tin.
in_the_box: The Biscuit Tin with 24 shortbread biscuits

compatibility.note: Biscuits are not chilled and travel by Soon or Sooner.
We do not sell an empty tin.

packaging: The tin travels in a kraft card box with paper-pulp cushioning.

warranty.summary: It has no warranty, because it is food. If it arrives damaged, see Damaged Items.

care: Keep in a cool, dry place with the lid on.
Eat by the best-before date on the tin.
safety: Contains wheat (gluten) and milk. Made in a kitchen that also handles nuts, egg and soy.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: It cannot be returned once opened. An unopened tin can be returned within 30 days. If it arrives damaged, see Damaged Items.
